title: An Advanced Course in the Long Throw
summary: Teaches a Champion to wring the greatest reach from a counterweight engine through balance and sling and qi in the throwing arm.

title: Canon of the Sustained Barrage
summary: Teaches an experienced crew to keep a trebuchet firing at pace through a long engagement without fatigue or fouled gear.

title: Treatise on Breaching the Rampart Foot
summary: Instructs crews to concentrate heavy shot on one stretch of rampart until the masonry fails and the breach opens.

title: Standing Orders for the Engine Battery
summary: Sets out the command of a battery of trebuchets that fire in turn on a shared range under one captain's calls.

title: Twin Beam Doctrine of the Paired Engines
summary: Teaches two trebuchets sited as a pair so that each reads and corrects the fall of its sister engine's shot.

title: Hawk Court Treatise on the Falling Stone
summary: Teaches the hawk court method of dropping heavy stone almost vertically onto a marked target under the open azure sky.

title: Basin Engine Ranks and River Stone
summary: Teaches engine ranks laid along a basin shore to throw stone across the river bed on the dual-track signal.

title: Wind-Sworn Treatise on the Oath Throw
summary: Teaches oath-bound crews to hold an engine on its bearing against the wind and to loose together on the oath word.

title: Plateau Bearings for the Open-Edge Engine
summary: Teaches setting an engine on an open plateau edge with no walls and keeping its bearing by wind and horizon.

title: Gale Oath of the Long Pull
summary: Teaches wind-sworn pull-teams to haul a traction engine on an oath count and hold it steady through gale gusts.
